name: Currency Rates
author: Widgeter
description: Daily exchange rates from a base currency to your chosen currencies with day change and a 30-day trend, from the ECB via Frankfurter.

config.label: Base currency
config.help: 3-letter ISO code of the currency you convert from, e.g. EUR, USD, DKK.

config.label: Convert to
config.default: USD, GBP, DKK, SEK, NOK, JPY, CHF
config.help: Comma-separated 3-letter codes. The ECB publishes about 30 major currencies. Up to 10 are shown.

config.label: Amount
config.help: How much of the base currency to convert.
